sourceChecks.note: The official Dietrich product page was checked on 2026-09-03 and confirms Skin Diver (SD-1) - Pacific Blue as the exact product configuration. It publishes 38.5 mm diameter, 12 mm height, 20 mm lug width, 46.2 mm lug-to-lug, approximately 145 g with the stainless-steel bracelet, Sellita SW200 automatic movement with 38-hour reserve, 150 m water resistance, and a date display. It publishes no separate manufacturer reference code.
The specialist review was checked and corroborates the Dietrich SD-1 Skin Diver family and Pacific Blue configuration; it is not used to invent a reference code.
